Fair ride collapses, averting major accident; children feared trapped

A Mickey Mouse-themed ride at the Shoolini fair in Solan suddenly collapsed. While initial reports suggested fears of children being trapped, subsequent accounts indicate that parents rescued approximately 10-12 children. The incident, though causing alarm, did not result in a major accident.
